proposals.title: Cut the log retention and no-removal statements from REQ-SAG-0003 and propose an anchor for them

changes.before: A session log MUST remain in `~/.sc-agent/sessions/` whatever its age.
A run log MUST remain in `~/.sc-agent/sessions/` whatever its age.
sc-agent MUST NOT contain code that removes a general log.
sc-agent MUST NOT remove a session log.
sc-agent MUST NOT remove a run log.

proposals.justification: ANC-005 asks that default loggers write under the configured log root with fixed folder and file names. It says nothing about keeping, rotating, pruning or removing logs. All five statements are retention rules (provenance commits f023c0d, 13c4513, 1a9af55 and 67203e2, 2026-11-19 to 2026-11-25). They add a guarantee the owner has not stated. Statements 0-3 (default path, `<CLI>_LOG_ROOT`, `<CLIENT>_LOG_ROOT`, session path) stay, because they carry out ANC-005. The record's rationale says session logs are the long-term record used to analyse tens of thousands of decisions, so I think the guarantee may be needed. At aggressive the excess is deleted until the owner anchors it. I did not check the code: only Read was available and no code path was known. The record's acceptance criteria about rotation and retention (the unit tests for session and run logs and the `rg` inspection for general-log removal) lose their statements if this is approved; the lead should handle them in the repair pass.
